research_question: Did validation-selected E4 real-domain adaptation reduce SID-Set real false positives while retaining CIFAKE transformation robustness and FLUX recall relative to frozen E3?
interpretation_guardrails: E4 was designed after inspecting both evaluation domains, so these are post-hoc results rather than a fresh test.
The frozen E4 threshold must not be changed from these results.
A new generator and authentic-image source are required for an unbiased external claim.
Aggregate metrics and non-image figures may be published; SID images may not be placed in the public demo.
